Name: Linda
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb? I'll be over at Vivian's house for a few hours. You kids have fun.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What kind of fun can we have when it's raining?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We could talk about our feelings.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, I'll rephrase it. What kind of fun can we have when it's raining?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I would not mind talking about my feelings.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Punches Baljeet) How do you feel now?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Whimpers) In pain.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There, we're done. I guess that was fun.

Name: Off-Screen Voice
Dialog: How about a game of hide and seek?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who said that?

Name: Boy
Dialog: I did!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who are you?

Name: Boy
Dialog: Allow me to introduce myself. (Walks over to Phineas and Ferb) I'm Irving. I'm your biggest fan! (Chuckles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How long have you been sitting there?

Name: Irving
Dialog: A couple hours. My horoscope says I'm a background type. (Raises book entitled "P & F") Check it out. I've kept a scrapbook of your adventures. (Opens book to a picture of Phineas, Ferb and co. on the rollercoaster) This is the time you built that rollercoaster . (Flips page to Phineas and Ferb on a Chariot at Paul Bunyan's Pancake Haus) And this is the time you built those chariots. (Flips to picture of Phineas and Ferb in the kitchen with Irving in the background) And this is when you had that soup .

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Scoffs) Oh, what a nerd.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that a lock of Ferb's hair?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Snatches book back) Don't touch it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Irving suggested hide and seek.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Isn't the house a little too small to play a good game of hide and seek?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps the problem is not that the house is too small, but that we are too big.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's right! You kids hang tight while Ferb and I use the technology from our submarine adventure to make a new shrinking machine. Ferb, I know what we're going to do today!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (reverently) You said the words. Hey, can I say the Perry thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wha?

Name: Irving
Dialog: You know, when you say "Where's Perry?"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: O...kay.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Where's Perry? Ah, oh wait, wait, I can do better. Where's Perry? Where is Perry? Wherefore art thou Perry? I wonder where that Perry went.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, where is that platypus? Where the P-man at?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. We've received some disturbing calls from Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? Monogram...are you home? If you're home, please pick it up. Pick it up. Hello? Oh, I hate these machines. Okay, listen. I'm being evil and I need Perry the Platypus to come over and stop me. (Beep) Wait-- wait, did I hear a beep? Did the machine just cut me off? Oh-ah-oh I don't know what to do. You know what, I'm just going to call back.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I want you to find out what he's up to and--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? I-- I think your machine cut me off before, what I was saying---

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Find out what Doofenshmirtz is up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here it is, a shrinking machine. Now, everybody touch the top of the machine.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow! We're really tiny! Phineas, your coffee table is huge!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Chuckling) Look at this pencil.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Somebody take a picture of me next to this dust bunny!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas, this is amazing! Everybody should shrink.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Get teeny.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Get tiny.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Be small!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (As Baljeet slides in) Safe!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, you caught me. I've been putting recyclable trash in the regular trash bin; I am so bad! You've taught me a valuable lesson. From now on, I'll be green. I'll be all the shades of green. (places circular device on Perry's back under pretense of patting it as he sees Perry out) They will call me El Verde, and tell my tale in Greenland. Goodbye now, drive safe, and thanks for busting down my door. I deserved it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright gang, we can start that game of hide and seek now.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Yells) Earthquake!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, it's Candace. Hey, Candace is it! Everybody hide!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone) Stacy, the bow is totally cute. It's your signature look. You have the bow, and I have (Pause) some weird metal contraption in the living room. (Runs up to it) Stace, I'll call you back. This thing was obviously made by Phineas and Ferb, so it must do something.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Running with Phineas) Phineas, look, on the umbrella stand!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no, she found me. I guess I'm it! (Screams as Candace opens the umbrella catapulting Baljeet to the ceiling, onto the lamp)

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I'm okay!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We gotta get that shrinker back!

Name: Irving
Dialog: You guys always have a plan.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have a plan.

Name: Irving
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll just have to wing it.

Name: Irving
Dialog: There's no winging, there's no winging in the book. You guys have just been improvising this whole time? (Dramatically) Oh, how heroes fall!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey guys! Remember me? Up here with the dead flies?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sit tight, Baljeet! We'll have you down as soon as we can.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How can I sit tight? With that air conditioner up there freezing me! (Teeth chattering) So cold. So cold.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Activate bug eye-bot. (The bug eye-bot activates) Yes, my little robot eye, find Perry's address for me. That's right, walk towards the front door so I can see the number. Oh, it will be so delicious to know where Perry lives. I can ring his doorbell...and run away! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Hey Mom?! I want to show you something! (normal voice, looks back) Yep, I'm one step ahead of you boys, one step. What the heck is this (presses antenna, shrinks) THIIIIIING! (Gasps) I'm shrunk! (Crashing noise as the shrinking machine falls next to her) Where's the reverse button?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Hello? Hello? I could have sworn I heard someone kno-- (Gasps) Oy. That's not a good place to put a toy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro! It's me, Candace! Helloooo!? (Screams and falls off ledge, onto the grass) Guess I deserve this for trying to be one step ahe-- (Screams, as she bumps into a growling caterpillar, which is shown to really be harmless after she runs away)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, we've got to get to that machine across the street.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Groaning) What's the point? We're vacuum bag filler.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Thanks for that, Captain Bring-Down.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Some kiddie TV show? Agh, the signal must have gotten switched. (Presses buttons) Aw, and now I've lost the picture entirely. (Pause) Hm. I hope it doesn't go rogue.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is that thing? Did we ever make mechanical bugs?

Name: Irving
Dialog: There's nothing in the book.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, split off now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thread 'em and throw 'em guys!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Come on, Fanboy, you want to live forever?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Is that an option?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (As Isabella jumps down, pulls out the needle embedded in the table leg, and takes over for him; faintly) I'm okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great job, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thank you very much.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (War cry) Yeah! Yeah! (screams. He rips off the bug's robotic eye and holds it above his head before throwing it down to the ground)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I couldn't have said it any better myself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was awesome, Phineas.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yeah, but guys? We're still small. What now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you're a genius! Everyone on?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Taking a picture) Hey, I don't have to digitally insert myself.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Go tell it to your blog.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's get Baljeet.

Name: Isabella and Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where is he?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't see him.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look over there, something's moving!

Name: Everyone but Ferb
Dialog: Ewww!Baljeet

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Pinky, no! Down! Bad dog. Where are your manners?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are you doing there, short stuff?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, thank goodness!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who smells like fly guts?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I had to survive, okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on! Hands on!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All right, Phineas!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yay, Phineas!

Name: Irving
Dialog: You did it, Ferb!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Isa, is that you?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Yeah, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted! Wait 'til Mom sees this! (runs off) Moooom?!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Giggles) She's gonna go get your mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Pounding his computer screen) Ohh. Work! Work!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on. Ooh, hey, random pounding works. Oh good, we're back on the Perry show.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ahhh! All right, Perry the Platypus, could you just do me a favor and hold this up to the street address in front of-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom! You gotta see something in the kitchen! (grabs her arm and drags her, only to spill her coffee) Come on, come on, come on, come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You think you're so clever, Perry the Platypus. But for the first time in my life I can actually use a self-destruct button that I have installed! Prepare to be vaporized, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Mom?! See, see?! (Sees nothing on the counter) WHAT?!! But it was right here!!! I swear there was this machine...and we were tiny...but then we got bigger... (rest is under) and, and...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain, overlapping) Oh, teenagers.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Hormones, all it is.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that's done. And no comeuppance.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do I feel so empty?
